title: EvidenceCoverageReport
description: Structured claim-level evidence coverage and sub-question verification representation for compound and multi-requirement queries.

original_query.description: The exact verbatim user inquiry string.

is_compound.description: True if the query was decomposed into multiple atomic requirements; False if evaluated as a single requirement.

decomposition_type.description: The structural strategy utilized to analyze the query.

sub_questions.description: The atomic sub-questions derived from the query, each with independent evidence grounding.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sub-question, e.g. sq_1.

aspect.description: The specific information target or attribute queried.

target_entity.description: The entity or product bounded to this sub-question, if applicable.

importance.description: Relative weight of this information requirement (1.0 = primary, 0.8 = secondary).

evidence_status.description: The evidence sufficiency status for this individual sub-question.

similarity_score.description: Top dense vector similarity score obtained for this sub-question.

supporting_chunk_ids.description: List of chunk IDs in the knowledge base that directly ground this requirement.

missing_information.description: Specific missing terms, clauses, or values not documented in retrieved chunks.

decision_reason.description: Explainable rationale justifying the evidence decision for this sub-question.

coverage_ratio.description: Weighted proportion of requested sub-questions that are supported by verified evidence.

supported_count.description: Number of sub-questions with evidence_status == SUPPORTED.

unsupported_count.description: Number of sub-questions with evidence_status == UNSUPPORTED.

conflicting_count.description: Number of sub-questions with evidence_status == CONFLICTING.

decision_rationale.description: Comprehensive explanation of how sub-question statuses yielded the overall evidence status.

claim_level_assertions.description: Detailed factual assertions generated in response to supported sub-questions.

claim_text.description: The factual assertion synthesized in the answer.

sub_question_id.description: The ID of the sub-question this claim addresses.

is_grounded.description: True if the assertion is strictly grounded in retrieved evidence.

supporting_citations.description: Sources/chunks cited in support of this claim.
